content_of_post_to_comment: It took me a painful 3 hours just to write 150 words… how do people just get in the flow of writing in a timely manner in a subject that you don’t care about?
comment: Honestly, writing about a topic you don’t care about is a different skill than just being “good at writing.” A lot of people who seem to flow are usually not writing perfectly on the first pass—they’re dumping a messy draft and fixing it later. I’ve found that lowering the bar for the first 10 minutes helps more than waiting for motivation to appear.
